service.description: Replays an approved request: stale check, then the stored service call as the approver with the gate switched off for this call only. The replay runs in its own transaction so a failure rolls back the change but still lets us record CcrFailed.
Email about a request: approval needed (to approvers except the requester) or the outcome (to the requester). Never fails the caller: a mail problem is logged and cleared.

Scheduled (ServiceJob ConfigApproval_Sweep). Expires pending requests past their expire date, and reminds approvers once about requests still waiting after config.approval.reminder.hours (default 24). Expiring never changes the target record: the change was simply never approved.
